scope: Qualified, rejected and scope-limited changes; percentages must not be multiplied to claim a cumulative speedup. Current run is strict 3312-day isothermal reservoir/wells without detailed surface network.

items.name: CPR CUDA graphs
items.note: Ordinary per-system CUDA graphs; distinct from experimental cross-system replay.

items.name: Persistent CPR replay
items.note: Not promoted: full Norne slower and trajectory changes.

items.name: Shared PVT row lookup
items.note: Early and late paired windows showed no speedup; not present as an accepted acceleration.

items.name: Fused FGMRES vector update
items.note: Early step-call window about 4.5% faster; no late-window or isolated full-run speedup established.

items.name: CSR diagonal preparation
items.note: Fewer CUDA synchronizations; about 2% observed late-window speedup, full-run isolated benefit not established.

items.name: Adaptive AMG reuse
items.note: Experimental; accuracy-preserving equivalence did not pass and late window did not accelerate.

items.name: Newton repair
items.note: Historical complete runs reduced rejected attempts from 33 to 3. Sources and adaptive grids differ; not an isolated optimization A/B.

items.name: Fallback Newton line search
items.current: enabled to reproduce preceding 499.453 s qualification
items.note: Previous full trajectory identical; three fallback retries did not rescue original failed steps, no acceleration attributed.

items.name: Native PR/Radau/private CPU input buffers
items.note: Separate detailed surface-network implementation; its speedups must not be claimed for plain Norne.
